सौवीर

SAUVĪRA . An ancient country near the river sindhu. It is stated in mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 133, that during the period of mahābhārata, the King of this country was killed by arjuna.

सौवीरी

SAUVĪRĪ . The wife of King manasyu, the son of pravīra and the grandson of emperor pūru. (mahābhārata, Ādi Parva, Chapter 94, Stanza 5).
